name: tokenpilot
description: Shrinks a chat turn, attaches the tools it needs, aligns the prompt to the task, and shortens the stored reply.

scripts.build: esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/extension.js --external:vscode --external:typescript --format=cjs --platform=node --sourcemap && esbuild src/hookEntry.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/turn-hook.js --format=cjs --platform=node && esbuild src/reduceCli.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/reduce.js --format=cjs --platform=node && esbuild src/proxyEntry.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/proxy.js --format=cjs --platform=node
scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && esbuild test/optimize.test.ts test/graph.test.ts test/bifrost.test.ts test/hook.test.ts test/harness.test.ts test/reduce.test.ts test/output.test.ts test/proxy.test.ts test/ide.test.ts test/userPrompt.test.ts test/history.test.ts test/jev.test.ts test/modelCatalog.test.ts --bundle --outdir=dist-test --outbase=test --platform=node --format=cjs --external:typescript && node --test dist-test/optimize.test.js dist-test/graph.test.js dist-test/bifrost.test.js dist-test/hook.test.js dist-test/harness.test.js dist-test/reduce.test.js dist-test/output.test.js dist-test/proxy.test.js dist-test/ide.test.js dist-test/userPrompt.test.js dist-test/history.test.js dist-test/jev.test.js dist-test/modelCatalog.test.js

tokenpilot.bifrostUrl.description: Bifrost gateway origin, without a path.

tokenpilot.bifrostPath.description: Chat completions path. Use /openai/v1/chat/completions if the gateway only exposes the OpenAI prefix.

tokenpilot.bifrostKey.description: Bifrost virtual key. When set, the proxy sends it as the bearer token. When empty, the key from Cursor is forwarded.

tokenpilot.proxyEnabled.description: Start the local proxy that strips each request before forwarding it to Bifrost.

tokenpilot.proxyPort.description: Port for the local proxy. In Cursor, set the OpenAI base URL to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 and add the Bifrost model ids.

tokenpilot.localUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible origin for the local model. Ollama listens on port 11434.

tokenpilot.localModel.description: Model id sent to the local server. Confidential repositories use only this model.

tokenpilot.rewriteModel.description: Small open model on tokenpilot.localUrl that rewrites the user prompt before it is sent. Pull it with: ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b. If it is not running, the prompt is still condensed locally.

tokenpilot.smallModel.description: Fallback Bifrost model for a light task. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is the free, low-cost model.

tokenpilot.strongModel.description: Fallback Bifrost model for an edit and the chat. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is the free, low-cost model.

tokenpilot.budgetUsd.description: Spending limit for the current user, in USD.

tokenpilot.userId.description: User id for the spending ledger. Empty uses the OS user name.

tokenpilot.confidential.description: Treat the open workspace as a confidential repository.
